title: Shoreline ABC
hook: Name the coast from A to Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: brief predictable pause before the answer
visualStyle: cheerful coastal storybook 3D, sandy shore plus blue water accents, rounded toy-like forms, crisp silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: child beachcomber naming what appears at the shoreline
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written shoreline quatrains using ABAB or near-ABAB rhyme across neighboring letter lines, with occasional internal echoes
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: search cue, brief gap, answer, then one small gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 guitar-forward and airy; chorus adds glockenspiel; Round 2 strips to bass pulse and hand taps
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft surf-guitar upstroke with glockenspiel answer
